body_lead: Bhubaneswar, Ap 25: In a first for Odisha, the Odisha University of Technology and Research (OUTR) has introduced an AI-powered attendance system, revolutionising the way attendance is tracked in classrooms. The newly launched system enables both students and faculty to mark their presence through a dedicated mobile application, eliminating the need for traditional roll calls and saving valuable teaching time. The move signifies OUTR’s bold stride towards digital transformation in education.
